_readme: Real chain capture for MaxFi position #757217 (Robinhood Chain, WETH/STONKBROKER), taken alongside the live maxfi.tech card for the same position. Replaces the Phase D synthetic reconstruction (deleted) - see Phase D.1 summary. All on-chain integers are stored as strings, matching the Phase A JSON-boundary convention; tests parse them to int.

expected._note: Independently verified against raw chain state and reconciled against the live maxfi.tech card (see the test module docstring for the card cross-check figures). If shipped code disagrees with these, fix the code, not these numbers.

card_cross_check._note: Reconciliation targets from the live maxfi.tech card, captured at the same moment. Documented for reference; only the uncollected and collected USD figures are asserted in tests (see STEP 1/STEP 3 of the Phase D.1 spec).
card_cross_check.collected_divergence_note: KNOWN AND EXPECTED - see maxfi_pricing.py module docstring. MaxFi appears to value collected fees at the price prevailing when collected, not current price; unrecoverable from chain state since cumulativeFees0/1 carry no timestamps. Do not chase this number.
